tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// bsangs mchod bdud rtsi sprin phung bkra shis char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

spros bral chos dbyings gdod nas dag pa'i thugs// bde chen ma 'gags longs spyod yongs rdzogs pa// du ma'i gar mkhan bla med sprul pa'i sku// rig 'dzin padma ka ras rtag skyongs shig /gang zhig chos kun gdod nas dri bral yang*// glo bur rab rib dri ma bsal ba'i phyir// sna tshogs chos tshul dpag med ston pa las// phrin las bsangs mchod rim pa brtsam par bya// de yang bdag gzhan byang chub sgrub pa yi// mi mthun rkyen rnams yongs su zhi phyir dang*// grib dang mi gtsang nad gdon sel ba dang*// 'dzam gling bde dang tshe bsod spel ba dang*// dbang du byed dang byes su 'gro ba dang*// lha ngo bstod dang nyam nga zhi phyir sogs// mdor na phrin las rnam bzhi ci sgrub kyang*// bsangs mchod brngan gyi rim pa bgyid par bshad// de la dang po gtsang ma'i sa phyogs su// bla ma dkon mchog chos skyong rten bkram pa'i// drung du gzhi dkar steng du snod gtsang mar// bla ma yi dam chos skyong gtor ma dang*// brngan dang gzhi bdag la sogs ci dgos pa'i// mchod gtor kun dang rin chen 'bru sman spos// dar zab phye mar chang dang zas sna'i tshogs// spyan gzigs ci 'byor ma lus kun tu bsham// bsang khang zlum po yid 'ong me sgo can// dug shing la sogs mi gtsang ma yin pa'i// shing sna tshogs tshad spungs pa'i phung por bcas// rol mo'i bye brag rnams kyang legs par bshams// de ltar bcas rnams tshogs par byas nas/ cho ga'i rim pa ni/ bla med bla ma phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi// bde gshegs rgyal ba dam chos dge 'dun dang*// yi dam ḍā ki chos skyong tshogs bcas la// bdag gzhan byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa// glo bur 'khrul rtog ma rig gis ldongs pa'i// nyam thag 'gro kun sgrol zhes deng nyid nas// rab brtan byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// sems can thams cad bde ldan sdug bsngal bral// dga' dang ldan zhing btang snyoms cher gnas shog

/ zhes skyabs sems dang tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod gtor la sogs pa bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta= oṃ swa bha wa= stong pa'i ngang las rin chen snod kyi nang*// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon zhabs bsil ba// me tog bdug spos snang gsal mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo dza gad bdud rtsi'i mtsho// dmar chen rakta dkar dmar ba liṃ tshogs// 'dod yon rgyal srid rnam mang spyan gzigs dang*// bsangs mchod brngan gyi yo byad la sogs pa// rgya chen zad med kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// so so'i yid bzhin bde skyid mthun rdzas tshogs// dpag med ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis// rnam par 'phrul pa'i longs spyod rmad byung ba// mkha' mnyam rgyun mi chad pa nyid du gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ a kā ro sa byin gyis brlab/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen seng khri pad zla'i gdan gyi steng du rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po nam mkha'i sku can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol stabs su 'dzin pa rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis yongs su spras pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad mchog tu 'bar ba/ de'i steng dang 'og dang bar gyi cha la rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bka' brgyud kyi bla ma/ rgyal ba shākya'i dbang po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ chos sku yum chen mo la sogs pa dam chos/ nye ba'i sras chen brgyad/ mchog zung la sogs pa dge 'dun gyi tshogs rnams dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam gyi lha rab 'byams/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ rdo rje ber can kun dga' gzhon nu la sogs pa dpal mgon chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/

gzhan yang ye shes dang las las grub pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ dam can rgya mtsho lha srin sde brgyad/ glo bur ba dang gnyug mar gnas pa'i yul lha gzhi bdag la sogs pa'i bsangs mgron gyi tshogs rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed sprin phung gtibs pa lta bus bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su badzra sa mā dzaḥ/ ༈ bde chen chos dbyings rab 'byams klong yangs nas// 'gags med thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar rol ba// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// zhi ba bsangs mchod 'bul gyi gshegs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi badzra sa mā dzaḥ/ ༈ rin chen rab bkod yid 'ong khrir// pad zla nyi gdan rab brjid pa// bam chen me ri 'bar ba'i klong*// ci bde'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// oṃ badzra ā sa na padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ ༈ /dngos 'byor yid sprul kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// lha rdzas zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che// dag cing dri med mchod yon zhabs bsil dang*// yid 'ong me tog rmad byung dri ngad bzang*// rab gsal sgron me tshim byed byug pa'i tshogs// phun tshogs ro ldan bza' bca' rab snyan sgra// 'dod yon rnam mang rin chen mchod pa'i sprin// sa dang bar snang ma lus yongs khyab pa// blo yis blangs te rgyal ba sras bcas la// kun tu gus pa'i sgo nas mchod par bgyi// brtse ba chen pos dgongs te bzhes nas kyang*// byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra ārghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ sogs kyis mchod/ dkon mchog rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ngo bo nyid// gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i gter// byin rlabs rmad byung rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// kun rtog ma rig 'khrul pas bslad pa rnams// yongs su 'dul phyir khro chags zhi ba'i nyams// dpag med rnam rol dngos grub kun stsol ba'i// yi dam lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje zhe sdang snying rje cher khros pa'i// gar gyi nyams ldan bstan srung rnal 'byor skyong*// phrin las kun sgrub ma hā kā la'i tshogs// chos skyong srung ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la//

sogs kyis bstod/ hūm̐/ rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas// bla ma dkon mchog spyan 'dren gshegs// mnga' gsol mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /byin rlabs dngos grub stsal du gsol// dag pa rab 'byams gzhal yas nas// yi dam lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs// mnga' gsol mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /byin rlabs dngos grub stsal du gsol// gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren gshegs// mnga' gsol= byin rlabs dngos grub stsal du gsol// dam tshig gnyan po'i pho brang nas// chos skyong srung ma spyan 'dren= mnga' gsol phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub tu gsol// bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas// bya rog mtshan can spyan 'dren gshegs// mnga' gsol= phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub tu gsol// rab 'jigs dur khrod gnas mchog nas// kun dga' gzhon nu spyan 'dren gshegs// mnga' gsol= phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub tu gsol// rang rang so so'i gnas mchog nas// yul lha gzhi bdag spyan 'dren gshegs// mnga' gsol= rnal 'byor 'dod don bsgrub par mdzod// kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang*// dmar chen rakta gtor ma dang*// bdud rtsi sman dang rtsi bcud dang*// rin chen sman sna mthun rdzas sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa yis// rtsa brgyud bla ma mnga' gsol lo// yi dam lha tshogs mnga' gsol lo// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnga' gsol lo// chos skyong srung ma mnga'= dpal ldan mgon po= ma hā kā la= bya rog mtshan can= seng ge'i gdong can= dpal ldan lha mo= dregs pa'i gtso bo= sde brgyad mthu chen= yul lha gzhi bdag= mchod 'os rgya mtsho mnga' gsol lo// gsol zhing mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyis// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod// dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// mi mthun rkyen rnams zhi ba dang*// 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsol//

zhes mnga' gsol bya zhing 'dir chos skyong sogs kyi gsol mchod dang rten 'dzugs sogs spro na bya'o// ༈ de nas phye mar gyi sum cha dar tshon 'bru sman sogs bsangs khang theg tu phul zhing me sbar/ chang phud sogs bran nas 'di skad do// kyai// chos dbyings bde chen lhun grub gzhal yas khang*// gdod nas spros bral byang chub phyogs kyis mdzes// rnam dag zhing 'dir byin gyis rlabs pa yi// rtsa brgyud bla ma dngos grub kun stsol ba'i// yi dam lha tshogs phrin las stang 'dzin pa// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams// brtse bas 'dir byon dgyes par bzhugs nas kyang*// de ring gtsang ma'i bsangs mchod 'di bzhes shig /dpag med bskal pa dang po shar ba'i tshe// skabs gsum pa dang pha rol 'khrugs pa na// dpag bsam rkang 'thung dri bzang spros pa yis// gdug pa'i sems bral bde ba ldan par byas// bar du rig 'dzin mtsho skyes rgyal po yis// gangs can skye dgu rnam grol lam bzang por// 'god tshe rdo rje'i tshul khrims dri bsung gis// ma rig dug lnga'i dri ma bcom par mdzod// da lta rnal 'byor rig 'dzin bdag cag gis// dngos grub phrin las ma lus bsgrub pa'i phyir// zhi ba bsangs kyi mchod pa 'di 'bul bas// bde legs yid bzhin 'dod don kun 'grub mdzod// kyai/ skyabs gnas dam pa khyed rnams la// de ring phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// mchod 'os rgya mtsho khyed rnams la// de ring dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// de ring gtsang ma'i bsangs mchod ni// skye 'gags spros bral 'byung ba lnga// rnam dag bde chen yum lnga'i klong*// khams lnga 'dus pa'i rang bzhin las// phyi snod 'jig rten snod kyi tshul// nang bcud sems can tshogs su 'khrungs// 'khor 'das rab 'byams klong yangs shar// spos dri ngad ldan 'dzam gling rir// 'byung lnga dag pa'i me tog 'khrungs// bdud rtsi shing gi 'bras bu smin// dri zhim spos kyi ngad ldan pa'i// bal bu gser stag tsandan dang*// lo bzang mu le gram shing dang*// sba smyug nge ba dā ru dang*// mkhan dkar dpag bsam ljon shing sogs// dag byed gtsang mar gyur pa yi// shing sna tshogs pa'i dud pa dang*// phye mar zas phud skyems dang ni// g.yag lug ra gsum gzugs 'gros dang*// dkar dmar mdangs ldan ba liṃ ta// rin chen dar zab 'bru sman dang*// rol mo sil snyan sgra dbyangs sogs// sa gzhi bar snang kun gang ba'i// dge dang mthun pa'i dam rdzas dang*// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yi// phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dod yon tshogs// bsangs kyi mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis// de ring mchod pa rab tu 'bul// kyai/

spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng na// dkon mchog kun 'dus ngo bo nyid// skyabs gnas dge legs yon tan zhing*// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma bsangs// shākya thub pa la sogs pa'i// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bsangs// sde snod rgyud sde la sogs pa'i// lung rtog dam chos thams cad bsangs// nyan thos byang sems la sogs pa'i// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad= rdo rje 'chang chen la sogs pa'i// bka' brgyud bla ma thams cad= kun tu bzang po la sogs pa'i// bla ma sku gsum thams cad= dpal mchog lū hi pa la sogs// grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi= ind+ra bo dhi la sogs pa'i// rnal 'byor grub chen brgyad po= 'phags pa klu sgrub la sogs pa'i// 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis= mar pa lo tsā la sogs pa'i// lo paṇa skyes mchog thams cad= sa ra ha la sogs pa yi// rgya gar paṇa grub thams cad= mi la ras pa la sogs pa'i// bod kyi grub chen thams cad= dwags po lha rje la sogs= bstan 'dzin skyes mchog thams cad= dus gsum mkhyen pa la sogs= sprul pa'i brgyud 'dzin thams cad= padma 'byung gnas la= rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma= dam pa sangs rgyas la= zhi byed brgyud pa thams cad= dī paṃ kā ra la= lam rim brgyud pa'i bla ma bsangs// shākya shrī la sogs pa'i// bka' gdams brgyud pa'i bla ma= ye shes mkha' 'gro la sogs= gcod yul brgyud pa'i bla ma= nā ro paṇa chen la sogs pa'i// chos drug brgyud pa'i bla ma= phyag chen brgyud pa'i bla ma= rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i bla ma= dbu ma brgyud pa'i bla ma= lam 'bras brgyud pa'i bla ma= man ngag brgyud pa'i bla ma= byang sdom brgyud pa'i bla ma= so thar brgyud pa'i bla ma= blo sbyong brgyud pa'i bla ma= mtshan nyid brgyud pa'i bla ma= bstan srung brgyud pa'i bla ma= brgyud pa so so'i bla ma= kaṃ tshang brgyud pa'i bla ma= sangs rgyas byang sems sprul pa'i sku// thabs mkhas 'gro don mdzad pa'i phyir// rang rang so so'i skur ston pa'i// rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad bsangs// zhi ba bsangs kyi mchod pa 'dis// nad gdon bar chad zhi gyur cig

/grib dang mi gtsang bsangs gyur cig /'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod// kyai/ dag pa longs sku'i gzhal yas nas// gar dgu'i nyams kyis rab dpa' ba// zhi khro rab 'byams rgya mtsho yi// yi dam lha tshogs thams cad bsangs// dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i// gnyis med dus 'khor lha tshogs= bde dgyes phag mo la sogs= ma rgyud lha tshogs thams cad= gsang 'dus gshed dmar la sogs= pha rgyud lha tshogs thams cad= rdor dbyings dpal rtse kun rig sogs// rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lha tshogs= rnam snang mngon byang la= spyod rgyud lha tshogs thams cad= dam tshig gsum bkod la sogs pa'i// bya rgyud lha tshogs thams cad= rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs= zhi ba'i lha tshogs thams cad= che mchog khrag 'thung la sogs= khro bo'i lha tshogs thams cad= yang dag rta mgrin la sogs= bka' brgyad bka' gter lha tshogs= rnam snang mi bskyod la= rgyal ba rigs lnga'i lha tshogs= rdo rje dbyings phyug la sogs pa'i// yum lnga'i lha tshogs thams cad= 'phags pa 'jam dbyangs la= bde gshegs rigs kyi lha tshogs= spyan ras gzigs dbang la sogs pa'i// padma rigs kyi lha tshogs= phyag na rdo rje la sogs= rdo rje rigs kyi lha tshogs= 'phags ma sgrol ma la= rigs kyi yum chen lha tshogs= nam mkha'i snying po la sogs= byang sems nye sras brgyad po= bha ra dhwa dza la sogs= nyan thos gnas brtan thams cad= rdo rje rin chen padma sogs// rigs lnga'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro= gnas mchog nyer bzhi la= dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad= ri rab rdul phran mnyam pa yi// mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs thams cad= mdor na rgyud sde bzhi la sogs// dag pa rab 'byams longs sku yi// yi dam zhi khro dpag med dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad bsangs// zhi ba bsangs kyi mchod pa 'dis// nad gdon bar chad zhi gyur cig /grib dang mi gtsang sangs gyur cig /'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod// kyai/

sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// rdo rje zhe sdang rab khros pas// drag po 'jigs byed skur ston pa'i// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas bsangs// dpal chen sdom pa cher khros pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas mnga' gsol zhing*// zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i skur bstan pa'i// bla ma mgon po dbyer med bsangs// bya rog gdong can la sogs= nag po stong gi lha tshogs= seng ge'i gdong can la= sha za 'bum gyi lha tshogs= yum chen rtsa 'jibs dmar mo sogs// ma mo bye ba'i lha tshogs= mkha' 'gro brgyad drug la sogs= sprul pa'i pho nya thams cad= drag shul gtum rngam 'jigs rung ba'i// las byed 'khor tshogs thams cad= dpal chen thugs sprul bka' nyan pa// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhing skyong zhing*// sha za khrag 'thung za byed che// bdud mgon ga ya dha ra= si na ra ma la sogs= yum chen bdud mo thams cad= bam ro pho mo la sogs= las byed sprul pa thams cad= rdo rje legs pa la sogs= bka' nyan sde brgyad thams cad= bdud dmag stong sde la= yang 'khor dmag tshogs thams cad= myur mdzad phyag drug ye shes mgon// legs ldan beng dang ber nag can// gur mgon zhal bzhi ma ning sogs// dpal mgon drag po thams cad= 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma ti// re ma dza dang re ma dzu// dud sol tsaṇṭi ka la sogs// dam can mo rgyud thams cad= zhing skyong ma mo mkha' 'gro sogs// gsang sngags rgyud kyi srung ma bsangs// rnam mang thos sras sngags kyi bdag /rdo rje legs pa srin mgon dang*// zhing skyong chen po la sogs pa'i// bka' srung mgon po 'khor bcas= jo mo bkra shis tshe ring sogs// yum chen ma mo thams cad= rmugs 'dzin dbang po la= nor lha gter srung thams cad= tshangs pa brgya byin la= gtsang rigs mgon po thams cad= ston pa sangs rgyas spyan snga ru// bstan pa srung bar zhal bzhes pa'i// bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// chos skyong srung ma thams cad bsangs// zhi ba bsangs kyi mchod pa 'dis// nad gdon bar chad zhi gyur cig

/grib dang mi gtsang sangs gyur cig /'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod// kyai/ rang rang phyogs su legs bzhugs shing*// phas rgol 'joms pa'i nus pa can// rnal 'byor stong grogs mdzad pa yi// dkar phyogs gzhi bdag thams cad= stong gsum khams na gnas pa yi// gzhi bdag ma lus thams cad= /ri rab lhun po'i gzhi bdag= gser ri bdun gyi gzhi bdag= rol pa'i mtsho bdun gzhi bdag= gling bzhi gling phran sa bdag= 'dzam bu'i gling gi sa bdag= rgya gar yul gyi sa bdag= sham bha la yi sa bdag= rgya nag yul gyi sa bdag= gangs can ljongs kyi sa bdag= li dang bal po'i sa bdag= klo dang mon gyi sa bdag= mnga' ris skor gsum sa bdag= dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i sa bdag= mdo khams sgang drug sa bdag= bod kyi mgur lha bcu gsum= srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu= bod khams brtan ma bcu gnyis= nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs= gnas chen yongs kyi srung ma= rdo rje gdan la sogs pa yi// gtsug lag yongs kyi srung ma= puṣpa ha ri la sogs= gdan sa yongs kyi srung ma= la phyi chu bar la sogs= dben gnas yongs kyi srung ma= gnas gsum skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa= rdo rje g.yu sgron la sogs= zhing skyong mkha' 'gro thams cad= khyad par yul 'dir gnas pa yi// phyogs skyong gzhi bdag thams cad= rang la 'go ba'i lha srung bsangs// pha mas brgyud kyi srung ma= slob dpon brgyud kyi srung ma= bka' brgyud yongs kyi= sa gzhi yul mkhar khyim lha= mtho ba gnam la gnas pa= dma' ba sa la gnas pa= bar snang khams la gnas pa= nyin ri dkar la gnas pa= srib ri nags la gnas pa= sra ba brag la gnas pa= brtan pa sa la gnas pa= gsher ba chu la gnas pa= tsha ba me la gnas pa= g.yo ba rlung la gnas pa= skye ba shing la gnas pa= 'gro ba lam la gnas pa= sdod pa gzhi la gnas pa= steng gi lha gnyan thams cad= bar gyi btsan gnyan thams cad= 'og gi klu gnyan thams cad= pho lha dgra lha thams cad=

mgon skyabs byed pa'i lha rnams= nam zla dus bzhi'i lha rnams= lo zla zhag dus sa bdag= spar kha sme ba'i sa bdag= gza' skar dus sbyor thams cad= mdun nas bsu ba'i lha rnams= rgyab nas skyel ba'i lha rnams= rgyab brten byed pa'i lha rnams= 'khor 'das gnyis la gtogs pa yi// sa 'og sa steng sa bla la// gnas pa'i 'byung tshogs ci mchis pa'i// gzhi bdag srung ma thams cad= zhi ba bsangs kyi mchod pa 'dis// nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod// grib dang mi gtsang sangs gyur cig /'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod//

de nas tshogs gtor gser skyems 'bul ba ni/ kyai/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs// rtsa gsum rig 'dzin bla med sprul pa'i sku// mnyam med thugs rje'i spyan ldan rin po che// mchod 'os rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dgongs su gsol// phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas rmad byung ba// dngos 'byor yid sprul tshogs gtor bdud rtsi dang*// rin chen 'bru sman gser skyems rgya mtsho'i tshogs// blo yis legs par blangs te 'phul bar bgyi// dam tshig nyams chag sdig sgrib ma lus bshags// bsangs so dag go tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// mi mthun rkyen zhi bde legs dpal 'byor rgyas// phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub bkra shis stsol// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang bsangs mchod dmigs gsal gang 'os yod tshe 'dir sbyar bar byas la/ kyai/ gzhan yang bsangs dang mchod 'os pa// so so'i mtshan nas ma thon pa'i// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang tshogs// chos skyong srung ma dam tshig can// yul lha gzhi bdag gnyan po'i tshogs// che dgu gnyan dgu thams cad dang*// mchog dman bar ma'i mgron gyi tshogs// yul lha nor lha rigs drug mgron// lan chags glo bur lhags pa'i mgron// bsangs dang mchod brngan byed 'os pa'i// bsangs mgron tshogs rnams thams cad bsangs// dri zhim spos kyi ngad ldan pa'i// bsangs dud lho sprin lta bu dang*// sdom pa dam tshig ma rmas pa// 'pho med tshul khrims dri bsung gis// snod kyi 'jig rten dri ma bsangs// rnam dag bde chen zhing du gyur// bcud kyi sems can dri ma bsangs// dri med sku gsum mngon gyur shog /sdig spyod mi dge'i dri ma bsangs// dkar phyogs yon tan rgyas gyur cig /'chal ba'i dri ma thams cad bsangs// kun kyang tshul khrims dri ldan shog /bsangs dang mchod pa 'di phul bas// dkon mchog mchod pas mnyes gyur cig

/dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub stsol// smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol// yi dam lha tshogs dgyes gyur cig /mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol// chos skyong thugs dam bskangs gyur cig /phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub par mdzod// snang srid gzhi bdag mgu gyur cig /rnal 'byor stong grogs ma lus mdzod// rigs drug 'dod pa tshim gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun zhi bde ldan shog /dri zhim ngad bzang bdug pa'i tshogs// char sprin 'khrigs pa lta bu dang*// bskal pa'i me chen 'bar ba ltar// nam mkha' sa gzhi kun khyab pas// nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen sregs// nyams grib bying rmug thams cad sol// bsangs kyis mi tshangs gang yang med// mchog tu dag pa nyid gyur cig /'gal rkyen bar chad ma lus zhi// mthun rkyen yid la ci mchis pa'i// 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub pa dang*// bkra shis dpal 'byor cher rgyas mdzod// ces brjod do// de nas mchod cing brngan bya ba la/ phye mar la sogs bran cing*/ hūm̐/ dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs dang*// gzhi bdag la sogs mgron rnams thams cad la// ci bcol phrin las dpag med bsgrub pa'i phyir// 'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho dam pa bzhes// dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la// phyag 'tshal sna tshogs mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// bslu med dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum la// phyag 'tshal sna tshogs mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs la// phyag 'tshal sna tshogs mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro thams cad la// phyag 'tshal sna tshogs mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma chen po dang*// myur 'gro g.yag lug rta khyi bya nag sogs// mnyes rdzas mchod sprin dpag tu med pa yis// dpal ldan ye shes mgon po thams cad brngan// bdud rtsi gser skyems mkha' lding la sogs pas// dpal ldan lha mo yum chen thams cad=

'dod yon me tog stag gzig gser dngul gyis// lha dang lha min tshogs rnams thams cad= rin chen gter bum 'bru sman dkar gtor gyis// sa bdag klu gnyan ma lus thams cad= sha chang sba smyug ra yi rnam lnga sogs// lha srin sde brgyad tshogs rnams thams cad= mthun rdzas bshos bu snying dang gtor ma yis// bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis thams cad= dri gsur changs bu bgegs gtor la sogs pas// dri za lan chags bgegs tshogs thams cad= mdor na so so'i yid dang mthun pa yi// mkho dgu'i longs spyod mthun rdzas dpag med kyis// sa phyogs 'di sogs kun la gnas pa yi// gzhi bdag mgron rnams thams cad brngan par bgyi// de ltar mchod brngan rgya chen bgyis pa yis// mchod sbyin yul rnams dga' zhing mgu ba dang*// rnal 'byor bdag cag bar chad kun sel zhing*// phrin las rgya chen 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzod// zhes 'bul/ ༈ de nas lam lha gsol ba ni/ phye mar gser skyems sogs phul nas/ kyai/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs// bslu med skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum// yul lha gzhi bdag tshogs bcas la// zhi ba bsangs kyi mchod pa 'bul// khyed rnams ye shes spyan dang ldan// byin rlabs dngos grub phrin las kun// bslu med stsol ba'i lam lha yin// lam lha mdzod la 'gal rkyen sol// kun tu dge ba'i stong grogs mdzod// lam lha gnyan po khyed rnams la// dri zhim bsangs mchod bdud rtsi 'bul// bdag cag 'khor bcas gar 'gro yang*// la chu 'phrang gsum dag las sgrol// 'jigs sar dgra jag chom rkun skyobs// mya ngan lam gol lam log tu// skad cig tsam yang mi 'khyams shing*// bde ldan bde ba'i lam bgrod nas// nyam nga'i bar chad g.yul las rgyal// gnas grogs longs spyod phun tshogs pa'i// mthun rkyen bkra shis 'dod don kun// bde blag nyid du 'grub par mdzod//

zhes brjod/ de nas slar yang 'dod don gsol ba ni/ kyai/ gsol lo mchod do bstod do// bsangs so brngan no// bsgrub bo brten no// kyai/ bslu ba med pa'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ rgyud sde rab 'byams dang 'brel ba'i yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ lha klu 'byung po sde brgyad mthu bo che khyed rnams dgongs su gsol/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu kun dang*/ khyad par du rgyal dbang dam pa dpal ldan karma pa yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i thugs kyi bzhed pa'i don kun bde blag tu 'grub cing*/ zhabs pad brtan pa dang phrin las g.yel ba med pa'i sdong grogs mdzad du gsol/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag rnams kyi nad gdon bar chad kyi rkyen rnams zhi zhing*/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags yon tan thams cad rgyas pa dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa dbang du sdud pa dang*/ gnod par byed pa'i dgra bo ci mchis pa tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ dus kun tu yang srung zhing skyob pa dang*/ sbed pa dang*/ gzhi byes la sogs pa'i bya ba gang brtsams pa thams cad kyang skad cig gis 'grub cing*/ 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su yang*/ nyam nga ba'i nad mtshon mu ge la sogs pa'i rkyen dang bral nas dus rtag tu rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la spyod pa'i bkra shis bde legs kyi dpal 'byor chen pos khyab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ ༈ /de nas g.yang len ni/ phye mar gyi lhag ma bsangs khang gi steng du bskor zhing mda' dar g.yabs nas 'di skad do// kyai/ bslu med dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum gyi// yon tan smin grol byin rlabs ma lus pa// khu ye de ring phywa dpal g.yang du len// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar rgyas dpal 'bar shog

/rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma thams cad kyi// rdo rje bzhi yi byin rlabs rmad byung ba// khu ye de ring phywa dpal g.yang du len// nyams dang rtogs pa'i mdzod sgo dar bar shog /yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi// dngos grub dpal 'byor rten 'brel dam pa rnams// khu ye de ring phywa dpal g.yang du len// mchog thun dngos grub ma lus thob par shog /bka' srung chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho yi// phrin las thogs med mthu rtsal nus pa kun// khu ye de ring phywa dpal g.yang du len// phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par shog /gter bdag nor 'dzin lha tshogs thams cad kyi// rin chen mi zad mdzod sgo ma lus pa// khu ye de ring phywa dpal g.yang du len// longs spyod mnga' thang dpal 'byor cher rgyas shog /mdor na srid zhi brtan g.yo snod bcud kyi// bkra shis dpal 'byor kun tshogs rgya mtsho kun// khu ye de ring phywa dpal g.yang du len// bsam don kun 'grub bkra shis dpal 'bar shog / de nas phye mar drangs la/ rjes kyi cho ga ni/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod cing*/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la*// sogs kyis bstod/ bdag cag ma rig dbang gyur pas// cho ga ting 'dzin 'chol ba dang*// mchod gtor g.yel sogs ma dag pa'i// tshogs rnams mgon pos bzod par gsol// yig brgya brjod de bzod par gsol/ ye shes 'jig rten lha tshogs kun// rang rang gnas su gshegs nas kyang*// bdag sogs sems can don slad du// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badzra muḥ sarba bhū ta gatstshaḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ chos dbyings mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di phul dges// bdag dang mkha' nyams sems can kun// srid zhi kun grol byang chub shog /bkra shis rab rgyas rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyi// bkra shis dpal 'bar mi mthun g.yul las rgyal// bkra shis yid bzhin dgos 'dod kun stsol ba'i// bkra shis mchog gis kun khyab bkra shis shog

/zhes sogs bsngo smon bkra shis rgyas par bya'o// zhes bsangs mchod bkra shis bdud rtsi char 'bebs 'di yang dhī tsha dbon po'i sprul sku rje btsun bla ma karma bstan 'dzin gyi dgongs don ltar/ gar dbang byang chub sku bzhi'i dbang phyug gis rang gzhan kun la phan pa'i blos 'og min dpal gyi mtshur phur/ rgyal ba zhes pa shing pho rta lo'i rang zhal thog mar tshes pa'i dus dag par bris pa bkra shis dpal 'bar mi mthun g.yul las rgyal ba'i phun tshogs mchog gis khyab par gyur cig / ༈ gsur bsngo shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs/ ༈ skyabs sems bsangs sbyangs sngon song nas/ stong par gyur pa de yi ngang*// bhrūṃ las gsur snod rgya che'i nang*// 'dod yon lnga ldan rang bzhin gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum dang*/ oṃ a pra ti su ru phu pa ye swā hā/ lan bdun brjod/ 'dod yon lnga ldan gsur mchod 'di// dri za'i rgyal po rab tu dga'// mi'am ci yi rgyal po dang*// zur phud lnga sogs dri za kun// khyad par skye 'gro ji snyed pa// snga lus bor zhing phyi ma'i lus// ma thob srid pa bar ma dor// gnas pa'i nyam thag tshogs rnams la// 'dod yon phun tshogs thob gyur cig /bar do yin par ngo shes nas// 'jigs skrag sdug bsngal las grol te// rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur// mngon par myur du 'tshang rgya shog /de ma nus kyang mi khom gnas// spangs te mtho ris lus len te// dam pa'i chos la spyod par shog / ces pa 'di rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rjes grub chen rang rig ye shes kyi ngor bris pa dge/// /lhag bsam gtong ba bdud rtsi'i sprin phung las// bkra shis 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs par gyi 'phrul// mtshur phu bla brang gong du bsgrubs pa'i dges// bstan 'gror bde legs dpyid kyi dpal rgyas shog// /
